jobs.description: PhD Position (m/f/d) – Krombach FellowFull- or Part-time | Fixed-term (36 months) | Institute of Human GeneticsJoin an internationally recognized research team investigating the genetic foundations of sleep disorders through large-scale genomic analyses and machine learning. As the Krombach Fellow, you will contribute to a global multi-ancestry research consortium and help advance precision medicine approaches for restless legs syndrome.Your responsibilities:- Design and conduct genome-wide association studies (GWAS) and large-scale multi-ancestry meta-analyses using international biobank and research datasets.- Apply advanced statistical genetics methods to identify and prioritize disease-associated variants, genes, and biological pathways. - Develop and benchmark machine-learning models for genetic risk prediction across diverse populations. - Integrate genomic, clinical, and functional genomics data to improve the understanding of sleep disorders and their biological mechanisms. - Build reproducible, version-controlled analysis pipelines on high-performance computing and cloud platforms. - Present research findings within an international consortium and contribute to high-impact scientific publications.Your profile:- Master’s degree (or equivalent) in bioinformatics, statistics, mathematics, computer science, machine learning, human genetics, epidemiology, or a closely related quantitative discipline. - Strong programming skills in Python and/or R to analyze and interpret large-scale genomic and health-related datasets. - Solid understanding of applied statistics, including regression models, multiple testing, and causal inference, enabling robust analysis of complex biological data. - Experience working with large datasets and high-performance computing environments to manage computationally intensive genomic analyses. - Interest in human disease biology and motivation to translate genetic discoveries into clinically relevant insights through collaboration with clinicians and experimental researchers. - Excellent written and spoken English skills to communicate findings effectively within an international research consortium and at scientific conferences.We offer you:- A temporary position with the possibility of extension- EGYM well pass, corporate benefits and discounts (e.g. Käfer), cafeteria, sports and cultural offers, company bike - Working in the heart of Munich at Max-Weber-Platz with very good accessibility by public transport such as the subway, S-Bahn or tram- Company pension plan through the Federal and State Pension Institute (VBL)- Self-realization through a varied and technically demanding job with interdisciplinary cooperation between various departments of the TUM KlinikumWe look forward to your application!For further information, please contact Prof. Dr. Juliane Winkelmann, Tel. 089 / 4140 - 1445Institute of Human GeneticsTUM KlinikumRechts der IsarIsmaninger Straße 2281675 MünchenIf the candidates’ suitability for the position in question is equal, severely disabled applicants shall be given preference.Interview-related costs can, unfortunately, not be reimbursed.

At HelloFresh, our mission is simple: to change the way people eat, forever. As a global digital-native FMCG company and the world's leading mealkit provider, we are transforming the traditional food supply chain through a data-driven, on-demand model that enables scalable and more sustainable food delivery. The HelloFresh Group includes eight brands serving customers across multiple meal occasions, including HelloFresh, Green Chef, EveryPlate, and Chefs Plate, as well as ready-to-eat meals from Factor and YouFoodz, meat and seafood subscriptions through Good Chop, and pet nutrition with The Pets Table. Through technology, data, and culinary innovation, we deliver personalized food experiences to millions of households worldwide. The Role : What’s in the BoxWe are looking for a talented Category Manager to become part of our European Strategic Sourcing Team. Your role will involve contributing to the development and implementation of category strategies spanning multiple markets across Europe. As an International Category Manager, you will collaborate closely with both local and global stakeholders and help ensure we source high-quality ingredients and packaging at the best costs.This position can be based in Paris or Berlin and we have openings across several categories, including Protein; Produce, Herbs and Fruits; Grocery & Dairy; and Packaging. You will be able to tell us which categories interest you most in your application, and we will match you to the best fit.Above all, we are looking for people who will make HelloFresh better. We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don't "tick all the boxes" but think you'd thrive in this role, we would like to learn more about you.What You'll Do : The Recipe- Shape the category strategy: Help build and roll out category strategies across European markets, aligned with our business objectives and supply chain needs, working hand in hand with senior team members.- Own supplier relationships and negotiations: Manage key supplier relationships across markets and lead negotiations within your scope to secure the best possible terms, working independently and constructively with internal and external stakeholders.- Drive savings: Identify and deliver cost reduction opportunities by leveraging volumes and improving processes across markets.- Build the numbers behind every decision: Develop robust cost models, run make-or-buy analyses and monitor key commodity prices, so we pay fair prices and make well-informed sourcing decisions.- Stay ahead of the market: Forecast future cost pricing using data, industry knowledge and Generative AI tools, track market trends, regulatory changes and emerging technologies, and challenge the status quo with ideas to improve our processes.- Lead projects and grow others: Drive short-term procurement projects, support long-term initiatives with cross-functional teams, solve non-routine topics autonomously (aligning regularly with your manager on priorities), and mentor junior team members, interns and working students.What You'll Bring : - Bachelor's or master's degree from a top-tier college or university, preferably in business, engineering, supply chain, finance, or science.- Minimum of 3 years of strategic procurement or production experience, preferably in the food or food-packaging industry, or alternatively as a management consultant with a focus on operations.- Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to take initiative, work independently, and drive implementation.- Strong communication skills and the ability to work successfully in flexible team structures around the world.- Strong organizational and project management skills with a track record of successfully implementing cross-functional projects.- Capability to excel in flexible global team structures amid a reasonable degree of uncertainty.- Comfortable contributing to and managing projects, including developing new processes, SLAs, and KPIs.- Strong at devising creative solutions to supply issues, as well as designing, communicating, and executing action plans for effective resolution.- Convincing track record of successful negotiations with external partners.- Strong quantitative and analytical skills.- Excellent English proficiency is required, another European language is a plus.- Willingness to travel internationally up to 25% of the time.What we offer: The Toppings- The chance to have a serious impact role on one of the most exciting foodtech companies in Europe- A vibrant & international environment with a great culture & DNA- A guaranteed steep learning curve and boost for your career- A passionate, proactive, driven and dynamic French team- Offices located in the center of Paris (Paris 1er)- Competitive compensation- Delicious reductions on our HelloFresh boxes- Top tier employee experience and employees perks (Alan Blue insurance, Swile (tickets restaurant), GymLib, reductions on transport)Ergänzende Informationen:Homeoffice:Umfang: Nach VereinbarungAnforderungen an den Bewerber: Erweiterte Kenntnisse: Produktion, FertigungExpertenkenntnisse: Lieferantenmanagement
